state_machine.description: Single operational state; previousValue retains the prior sampled DWORD.

transitions.action: After calculating both edge masks, set previousValue to the sampled value.

priorities: Use the same pre-scan previousValue and sampled input for both edge masks; update previousValue only after both masks are calculated.
Process every invocation without gating. No safety, reset, or stop interface is specified.
Detect changes between consecutive samples only; changes occurring entirely between invocations are not observable.

initial_values.note: These are fresh-instance values before the first invocation. Nonzero input bits on the first scan are rising edges.

scan_execution_order.name: Edge sampling
actions: Sample value once into a local DWORD.
Calculate local rising mask as sampledValue AND NOT previousValue.
Calculate local falling mask as previousValue AND NOT sampledValue; restrict complements to 32 bits.

scan_execution_order.name: Safety/reset priority and state transitions
actions: No safety or reset conditions are specified; remain in RUN.
After both masks are calculated, assign previousValue := sampledValue.

scan_execution_order.name: Unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF
actions: No timer FBs are required; there are no calls in this stage.

scan_execution_order.name: Unified output assignments
actions: Assign risingBits and fallingBits from the local masks.
Assign each USINT count to the population count of its mask, in the range 0 through 32.
Set each edge flag according to whether its mask is nonzero; set hasChanged according to whether either mask is nonzero.
Overwrite all outputs on every invocation.

formal_assertions.formula: G(((risingBits AND value) = risingBits) & ((fallingBits AND value) = DWORD#0))
G((hasRisingEdges <-> risingBits <> DWORD#0) & (hasFallingEdges <-> fallingBits <> DWORD#0) & (hasChanged <-> (hasRisingEdges | hasFallingEdges)))
